summary: crates/toc-layout rev 4: FT-034's "existing consumer integration fixture and measured unsupported gaps". Grepped for real section producers first (crates/document-style/src/fonts.rs::SectionSpec is heading styling, not a page record; crates/document-runtime is queue/decode-lane plumbing and crates/project-index is bibliography/citation/search indexing -- neither has anything sectioning-shaped) and found the real producer: crates/compiler's Block::Heading (parser.rs's "section" | "subsection" match arm is the only place it's constructed) plus LayoutCursor::render_prepared_block's real PlacedItem::page_index (the exact prepare_block/render_prepared_block loop layout::layout_with_constraints itself runs). Added flashtex-compiler as a tests-only [dev-dependencies] entry (the library keeps an empty [dependencies] table) and tests/producer_fixture.rs: adapts that real, unmodified compiler output -- never a hand-built EntryRecord -- into SourcedEntry/RelativeEntry and runs it through stabilize_toc + layout_entry (3 tests: real multi-page pagination actually happens; the full stabilized-and-laid-out 7-entry pipeline is internally consistent; independent re-parses converge to a byte-identical StabilizedToc). No fixture under tests/tex-corpus has any sectioning at all (grepped: 0/14 real corpus projects), so the fixture's LaTeX input is authored in-test and labelled a stand-in; the compiler processing it is real and untouched. tests/measured_gaps.rs (1 pinned test) measures the real corpus exactly: 14 documents, 0 with supported sectioning, 0 with an unsupported construct (starred sections/subsubsection/paragraph/part/chapter/appendix/custom counter numbering -- none present to find), 0.000 entries/doc average, and -- via a geometry-derived FrontMatterModel stand-in, since no real rendered-TOC page-count producer exists either -- every document converges in exactly 2 passes, 0/14 anywhere near the 8-pass bound. Rev 2/3 coverage (cycle-vs-unresolved classification, determinism, staleness, adversarial bounds, exact identity) all still passes unmodified. 50 tests + 1 doctest pass; clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --check clean.
